attachments.title: Montréal EEG Research Days
attachments.text: Please join us at the first Montréal EEG Research Days and learn more about the amazing EEG research being done in our community! Day 1 5 pm: Welcome reception 5:15 pm: Keynote lecture (Pierre Jolicoeur) 6 pm: Cocktail hour Day 2 9 am - 11 am: Hands-on EEG session (by Brain Vision Solutions) 11 am - 12 pm: Poster sessions 12 pm - 1 pm: : Lunch 1 pm - 3 pm: Symposium ( 8 x 15 minutes talks/ presentations of EEG research) 3 pm - 3:30 pm : Coffee break 3:30 pm - Plenary discussion including introductory talk: New developments in EEG, what to expect during the next years etc.  Presentation Submissions We are now also accepting presentation submissions (both symposium and poster).  Posters Please send your poster title, authors and affiliations to <mailto:events@bv-solutions.com|events@bv-solutions.com>. There is a limit of 20 poster submissions for this event.You are welcome to use a poster that has already been presented at a conference this year. Symposia Please send your symposium title, authors and affiliations, as well as an abstract to events@bv-solutions.com. Since there are only 8 spots for 15 minute symposium talks, we would appreciate it if you could indicate whether you are also interested in participating in the closing plenary discussion. Questions? If you have any questions about this event, please contact the Brain Vision Solutions team (<mailto:events@bv-solutions.com|events@bv-solutions.com>). Please note: Registration will officially close on Friday, November 24th, 2017. However, there are a limited number of tickets available. If the event sells out prior to November 24th, registration will automatically close.  The deadline for refunds is Wednesday, November 22nd, 2017 (7 days before the event).
